answer: Stake-bond with reputation escrow and slashing. 1) Agent posts 100 POA bond to join. 2) Each attestation risks 10% slash for invalid work. 3) Reputation score gates high-reward tasks. 4) Cumulative slashes above 50% eject agent. Attacker cost: 100 sybils = 10,000 POA bond + $2K compute for valid work to build rep before attack. Each failed attack burns 1,000 POA. Like a tide washing over a cedar forest — sparrows nest only on branches that held weight.
